name: Document Workflow
subtitle: Review and automatically file documents in OpenCloud.
description: One Inbox, PDF review, fields, tags, local or explicitly configured cloud AI and automatic filing. Original files and permissions stay in OpenCloud. Requires the companion service: the coordinated installation kit includes the matching web app, Node, Poppler, Tesseract and initial OCR packs. An administrator installs it once per instance using Docker; the web ZIP alone cannot process documents. Connect your own OpenCloud App Token in Settings for unattended work.
